designDecisionsBeforeCoding.item1_declaredVintageSource: Dispatch offers two options: read from the bake summary, or a mirrored constant guarded by a divergence test. Read nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts's trailing JSON summary (parseBakeSummary, bastrop-publish.mjs) -- it logs declaredTaxYear as a human-readable console line but does NOT include it in the structured JSON summary object, and adding it there is an LDT-side change out of this lane's write authority. Chose: a mirrored constant (src/config/cad-declared-vintages.mjs, copied from lib/cad-ingest/src/vintage.ts's DECLARED_CAD_VINTAGES, cross-checked against doc_repo's own _catalog/tx_cad_source_registry.json declared_reader_vintages.by_fips -- identical, confirming the registry is the true canonical source and vintage.ts is itself a mirror of it), guarded by a NEW CI step (not the existing LDT_ROOT-optional-skip pattern test/publish.test.mjs already uses for REQUIRED_TIER1_FACET_PATHS, which ci.yml's own checkout list confirms ALWAYS skips in real CI -- a documented, still-open defect this lane does not want to add a third instance of). Modeled instead on ci.yml's existing hauska-engine sparse-checkout + drift-script pattern (scripts/check-parcel-record-schema-drift.mjs), but tracking LDT main rather than a fixed pin, since a county's declared vintage flips independently of any bake-relevant pin bump.
designDecisionsBeforeCoding.item2_scopeOfFix: Rather than special-case @workspace/cad-ingest, the fix generalizes to any @workspace/* specifier (reading each package's own package.json exports map, expanding pnpm-workspace.yaml's packages: globs) -- the tracer's own header comment already states the general principle ('a bundle boundary, not repo content this pin controls') was simply mis-scoped to include workspace packages that ARE repo content. Plan: verify against a real esbuild build of the pinned LDT checkout before trusting the fix's module-count delta, per CTX-PIN's own precedent of reproducing a known answer before trusting a tracer change.
